detailed_descriptions.en: From a room in Hell's Angels to a mansion with the best parties, missions that keep making the house better and better, and girls knocking on your door wanting to heat things up. That's how the third season of FreshWomen begins. Not everything went as planned last season, but the address is different now and the chance to start over is yours. Just don't think it'll be easy to handle it all on your own. And you don't face any of it without help. Julia, Chloe, Alyssa, Susan, Sue and the other girls are with you in the missions and in the fun, and if you know how to make the most of it, some of them can end the night a lot more intimate with you. Speaking of girls, there are new faces coming, like Riko, Naomi, Himiko, Brooke... well, there are more, but you'll meet them all yourself! Each one likes something different, and finding out what it is is up to you. Outside the mansion, life goes on, with college, the competitions and Dylan with his new calling in theater. And there are still secrets to come up along the way. All of that with humor, sex and the rewards you know you deserve. How it happens is up to you. Make the best choices and have fun. FreshWomen - Season 3 has: Over 9,000 gorgeous 4K renders; Over 1,200 animations in 60 FPS; Over 270,000 words; Over 17 hours of gameplay; Translations for: English, Spanish, French, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Italian, Korean, Polish, Japanese, Czech, Thai, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Russian; Full voice acting in Brazilian Portuguese and English, sexy sounds and moaning; Sweat, physics and HD maps for all characters;

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
From a room in Hell's Angels to a mansion with the best parties, missions that keep making the house better and better, and girls knocking on your door wanting to heat things up.

That's how the third season of FreshWomen begins.

Not everything went as planned last season, but the address is different now and the chance to start over is yours.

Just don't think it'll be easy to handle it all on your own.

And you don't face any of it without help. Julia, Chloe, Alyssa, Susan, Sue and the other girls are with you in the missions and in the fun, and if you know how to make the most of it, some of them can end the night a lot more intimate with you.

Speaking of girls, there are new faces coming, like Riko, Naomi, Himiko, Brooke... well, there are more, but you'll meet them all yourself! Each one likes something different, and finding out what it is is up to you.

Outside the mansion, life goes on, with college, the competitions and Dylan with his new calling in theater. And there are still secrets to come up along the way.

All of that with humor, sex and the rewards you know you deserve.

How it happens is up to you. Make the best choices and have fun.

FreshWomen - Season 3 has:

  • Over 9,000 gorgeous 4K renders;

  • Over 1,200 animations in 60 FPS;

  • Over 270,000 words;

  • Over 17 hours of gameplay;

  • Translations for: English, Spanish, French, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Italian, Korean, Polish, Japanese, Czech, Thai, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Russian;

  • Full voice acting in Brazilian Portuguese and English, sexy sounds and moaning;

  • Sweat, physics and HD maps for all characters;
